title: ArtifactManifest
description: Execution artifact manifest for a standard archive (tar.gz). Integrity is per-file sha256; nothing in the manifest may carry plaintext credentials, business data, or online platform ID lookup prerequisites; backend-specific graphs/scripts live in backend_ns (other backends never need to understand them). There are no installer-script fields: loaders MUST NOT execute installation scripts, and unknown executable declarations are rejected. entry and file paths are archive-relative; leading '/' and '..' segments are rejected.

publisher_ref.description: Publisher identity resolved against host-configured trust roots, never trusted merely because declared here.

license_expression.description: License declaration evaluated against host policy before loading.

signature_ref.description: Detached signature or attestation reference binding the exact manifest and file digests. Missing means unverified; digest validation alone is not publisher authentication.

backend_ns.description: Backend-specific namespace (e.g. pregel graph definitions). Generic fields never require any backend to understand a vendor DSL.

archivePath.description: Portable relative regular-file path; no drive prefix, backslash, NUL, empty segment, '.' or '..'. entry must name a listed file. Archives contain exactly the listed regular files, with no duplicate names, links, directories or devices.
